body.text: If you're trying to conceive, understanding your fertile window can make a real difference. This is the span of days each cycle when pregnancy is most likely to happen — and knowing exactly when it falls can help you plan intimacy with confidence.

Your fertile window typically spans six days: the five days leading up to ovulation and the day of ovulation itself. Sperm can survive in the body for up to five days, while an egg is viable for only 12 to 24 hours after release.
Signs of ovulation to watch for

items: A slight rise in basal body temperature
Increased libido and heightened sense of smell

body.text: Tracking just two or three signs together is far more reliable than relying on the calendar alone.

The most accurate approach combines temperature tracking, cervical mucus checks, and ovulation predictor kits. Logging all three in Srikandi Promil helps our predictions get sharper with every cycle you track.
